# Incode

> Italian creative studio, founded in 2007, specialising in full-stack development: websites, e-commerce, custom web applications, UX/UI design and UX research.

Incode (legal name: Incode Srl) builds digital products for agencies and brands. Operating office in Cremona, Italy; registered office in Asola (Mantua), Italy. Working languages: English and Italian. Service area: Italy and Europe.

Tagline: You think. We build.

Last updated: 2026-08-05

## Contact

- Website: https://www.incode.it
- Email: info@incode.it
- Phone: +39 0372 027375 (Monday to Friday)
- VAT: IT01357300191

## Services

- Websites & E-commerce: WordPress, WooCommerce, Drupal, Drupal Commerce, Shopify; B2B and wholesale portals with customer-specific catalogues and price lists
- Custom web applications: Ruby on Rails, Node.js, Vue.js, Astro; management platforms, product configurators, booking systems, data dashboards, geoportals, LLM-based tools
- UX & UI design: Figma design systems, component libraries and documented guidelines, standalone or as the first phase of a build
- UX research & usability testing: heuristic evaluations, moderated usability tests, benchmarking, A/B and metric-based testing (since 2018)
- White-label development for agencies: technical subcontracting under the agency's brand, from front-end and CMS work to full back-end builds
- Migration & replatforming: takeover of sites built by other suppliers, legacy CMS content migration, Drupal 7/8/9 to Drupal 11 upgrades
- Maintenance & technical support: security updates, CMS version upgrades and incremental development for production sites, including platforms Incode did not build
